tasks.label: Build and Deploy Firebase Hosting + Functions
tasks.command: npm run build ; npm --prefix functions run build ; firebase deploy --only hosting,functions

tasks.label: Deploy Firebase Hosting + Functions (PS compat)
tasks.command: npm run build ; npm --prefix functions run build ; firebase deploy --only "hosting,functions"

tasks.label: Deploy Functions then Hosting (PS safe)
tasks.command: npm run build ; npm --prefix functions run build ; firebase deploy --only functions ; firebase deploy --only hosting

tasks.label: Build + Deploy Assist Feature
tasks.command: npm run build ; npm --prefix functions run build ; firebase deploy --only functions:api ; firebase deploy --only hosting
